package.name: autoware_lanelet_tag_publisher
package.description: Minimal standalone node that watches the vector map and ego pose and publishes a debounced Bool indicating whether ego's current position lies inside ANY lanelet tagged with a configurable boolean attribute (default: enable_master_local_control). Does not subscribe to the route — this is a pure point-in-polygon containment check against the lanelet map, independent of route/mission state.
